verdict.rationale: Snowflake docs show resource monitors that track warehouse credit usage and suspend a standard warehouse, or disable an Adaptive Warehouse, when it hits a credit limit. Supporting cost controls include user-managed warehouse credit consumption, per-user quotas (GA), cost anomaly monitors (preview) and notification integrations for cost anomaly alerts, and a community user recommends setting up resource monitors. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of idle-warehouse auto-suspend, a per-query timeout that kills a single runaway query, a documented budgets feature, and hands-on corroboration that monitors actually stop overnight spend.
